title: David’s Song of Thanks

questions.question: Where was the ark of God set?
options: Inside the tent that David had pitched for it
questions.correctAnswer: Inside the tent that David had pitched for it
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 16:1 (ESV): "And they brought in the ark of God and set it inside the tent that David had pitched for it..."

questions.question: What did David distribute to all Israel, both men and women?
options: A loaf of bread, a portion of meat, and a cake of raisins
questions.correctAnswer: A loaf of bread, a portion of meat, and a cake of raisins
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 16:3 (ESV): "...to each a loaf of bread, a portion of meat, and a cake of raisins."

questions.question: Who was appointed as chief to invoke, thank, and praise the LORD?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 16:4-5 (ESV): "Asaph was the chief, and second to him Zechariah..."

questions.question: What song did David deliver to Asaph on that day?
options: Oh give thanks to the LORD; call upon his name
questions.correctAnswer: Oh give thanks to the LORD; call upon his name
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 16:7-8 (ESV): "Then on that day David first appointed that thanksgiving be sung... Oh give thanks to the LORD; call upon his name..."

questions.question: Who were the gatekeepers for the ark?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 16:38 (ESV): "Obed-edom... and Hosah were to be gatekeepers."

questions.question: Before whom did David leave Asaph and his brothers to minister regularly?
options: Before the ark of the covenant of the LORD
questions.correctAnswer: Before the ark of the covenant of the LORD
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 16:37 (ESV): "So David left Asaph and his brothers there before the ark of the covenant of the LORD..."

questions.question: Where was Zadok the priest left to minister?
options: Before the tabernacle of the LORD at the high place in Gibeon
questions.correctAnswer: Before the tabernacle of the LORD at the high place in Gibeon
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 16:39 (ESV): "And he left Zadok the priest... before the tabernacle of the LORD at the high place that was at Gibeon,"

questions.question: What were Heman and Jeduthun appointed to do with trumpets and cymbals?
options: To give thanks to the LORD, for his steadfast love endures forever
questions.correctAnswer: To give thanks to the LORD, for his steadfast love endures forever
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 16:41-42 (ESV): "With them were Heman and Jeduthun... to give thanks to the LORD... Heman and Jeduthun had trumpets and cymbals..."

questions.question: What covenant did God make with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob?
options: To give them the land of Canaan as their portion for an inheritance
questions.correctAnswer: To give them the land of Canaan as their portion for an inheritance
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 16:16-18 (ESV): "...saying, 'To you I will give the land of Canaan, as your portion for an inheritance.'"

questions.question: What rebuke did God give kings for their sake?
options: Touch not my anointed ones, do my prophets no harm!
questions.correctAnswer: Touch not my anointed ones, do my prophets no harm!
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 16:21-22 (ESV): "...he rebuked kings on their account, saying, 'Touch not my anointed ones, do my prophets no harm!'"

questions.question: Who was the son of Jeduthun mentioned at the gate?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 16:38 (ESV): "...also Obed-edom the son of Jeduthun and Hosah were to be gatekeepers."

questions.question: For what purpose were burnt offerings offered on the altar at Gibeon?
options: Morning and evening according to the Law
questions.correctAnswer: Morning and evening according to the Law
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 16:40 (ESV): "to offer burnt offerings to the LORD... morning and evening... according to all that is written in the Law of the LORD..."

questions.question: Who sounded the trumpets regularly before the ark of the covenant?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 16:6 (ESV): "and Benaiah and Jahaziel the priests were to blow trumpets regularly before the ark..."

questions.question: What are the families of the peoples ascribed to the LORD?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 16:28 (ESV): "Ascribe to the LORD, O families of the peoples, ascribe to the LORD glory and strength!"

questions.question: Who played with lyres and harps?
options: Zechariah, Jaaziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Mattithiah, Eliab, Benaiah, Obed-edom, and Jeiel
questions.correctAnswer: Zechariah, Jaaziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Mattithiah, Eliab, Benaiah, Obed-edom, and Jeiel

key_verse_text: Oh give thanks to the LORD, for he is good; for his steadfast love endures forever!
